evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.999 Torr at growth setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure rose to 3.050 Torr, then increased each observation to 3.152 Torr at 3120 s despite unchanged setpoints.
Temperature 750.2 °C and Ar flow 100.3 sccm track setpoints, while pressure is about 5% above early-growth baseline; heater power is 44.1%.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; pressure and Ar flow cannot establish atmospheric purity.

args.missing_evidence: Pressure acceptance limits and normal growth-stage pressure trend; oxygen measurement, leak testing, and exhaust/pumping checks to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
